data.name: Gauraang
data.gender_notes: Gauraang is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gauraang is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'gauri' meaning 'golden' and 'ang' meaning 'form' or 'manifestation'. This name signifies a person with a radiant and golden hue, often associated with divinity and spiritual enlightenment. The name Gauraang carries the meaning “Golden hue, Radiant form” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gauraang usually hope their child will grow to embody golden hue, radiant form and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gauraang belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden hue, Radiant form.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gauraang total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Gauraang Mahaprabhu was a prominent figure in the Bhakti movement in Bengal during the 16th century. He is known for popularizing the chanting of the Hare Krishna mantra.

Gauraang Mahaprabhu is also known as Nimai Pandit, and he was born in the village of Roddha in Bengal in 1449. He is considered an incarnation of God Krishna, and his teachings emphasized the importance of devotional love for God.
